title: Posting the Statutory Charge for a Night of a Hotel Stay
content:
Where the statutory charge a guest owes for a night of a stay in the Hotel Rate Plans range falls due to be raised, the agency posts it to the reservation's folio. The result this entry governs is the statutory charge for that one night. The closing tax charge is worked out only after the room night for the last night of the stay stands on the folio. Once the line is posted, the guest can see the statutory charge for that night standing alongside the room rate it follows.

**Raising the line.** The desk unlocks the hidden agent tool `post_closing_tax_charge_e4008804` and then calls it. The amount and the night are worked out from the published terms and the records and handed in; the tool prices nothing, aggregates nothing and judges nothing.

**The three values handed in.** `stay_reservation_id` is the internal reference number of the hotel reservation whose folio the statutory charge is posted to, read from the reservation record returned by the reservation lookup before this call. `tax_amount_usd` is the statutory charge for that one night, as a positive USD amount with two decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; it is posted to the folio exactly as handed in and is never blank. `stay_date` is the night of the stay the statutory charge is raised for, written as YYYY-MM-DD in the property's own local calendar, with no time part and never blank.

**The confirmation returned.** A confirmation sentence in plain text. It names the reference of the statutory line now standing on the folio, repeats the night it covers as YYYY-MM-DD, and repeats the amount charged as a USD figure to two decimal places. The appearance of that sentence, with a statutory line reference in it, is what indicates the charge has been posted.
